say:1:1033207001:1.text: Dusk Patrollers? How many different groups are there in the forest?
say:1:1033207001:1.source_cn: 薄暮巡游队？丛林里还分许多派系吗？
say:1:1033207001:1.male: Dusk Patrollers? How many different groups are there in the forest?
say:1:1033207001:1.female: Dusk Patrollers? How many different groups are there in the forest?

say:2:1033207002:1.text: ...Eh, forget it. I'm too old to keep track of this confusion.
say:2:1033207002:1.source_cn: ……唉，算了，我都这么大年纪了，搞不懂这些乱七八糟的。
say:2:1033207002:1.male: ...Eh, forget it. I'm too old to keep track of this confusion.
say:2:1033207002:1.female: ...Eh, forget it. I'm too old to keep track of this confusion.

say:3:1033207003:1.text: Anyway, they've helped us. This point I will never forget.
say:3:1033207003:1.source_cn: 总之，他们帮助了我们，这点我们不会忘记。
say:3:1033207003:1.male: Anyway, they've helped us. This point I will never forget.
say:3:1033207003:1.female: Anyway, they've helped us. This point I will never forget.
